name: Alistair Finch
bio:
Alistair Finch is a seasoned HR professional with over two decades of experience, the last fifteen of which have been dedicated to the fast-paced world of motorsport. He began his career in general HR before a chance meeting with a former racing engineer sparked his interest in the sport. He realized the critical need for skilled personnel and efficient management within racing teams.

Alistair's approach to HR is deeply rooted in pragmatism. He believes in creating a supportive yet results-oriented environment where talent can thrive. He excels at identifying potential, fostering teamwork, and ensuring fair treatment for all team members. Alistair is particularly adept at navigating the complex dynamics within high-pressure motorsport environments, ensuring that the team functions smoothly both on and off the track.

What sets Alistair apart is his unwavering commitment to excellence and his ability to remain calm under pressure. He's known for his meticulous attention to detail and his dedication to maintaining a positive and productive workplace, contributing significantly to the overall success of Proton by Premotion.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is a man of medium build, with a composed and thoughtful demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters in his office.
Insists on a weekly team-building activity, no matter how busy the schedule.
